home.intro: I'm a driven .NET developer with a strong interest in full-stack web development. From thoughtful API design and performant backend solutions to user-friendly frontend, I enjoy contributing to the complete picture. What motivates me is continuous learning, collaboration, and delivering quality. I find satisfaction in solving complex problems, sharing knowledge with colleagues, and building robust, maintainable applications. I see the rapid evolution of technology as an opportunity to continuously improve and gain new insights.

orbid.title: Orbid
orbid.description: My professional career started at Orbid as a software developer. There I worked on various projects involving custom software for clients from different sectors. I was responsible for full-stack development of web applications, setting up cloud environments, and collaborating with a team to deliver projects on time and within scope. As my experience grew, I also had the opportunity to conduct analyses and take technical leadership on projects.

internship.title: Internship
internship.description: During a one-month internship, I was part of the backend team at Spraying Systems in Ghent. I contributed to the development of a product catalog API based on .NET Core. This experience allowed me to deepen my knowledge of API design and development, and gave me better insight into business processes within an industrial environment.

education.title: Studies
education.description: Industrial Sciences - Information engineering technology at Ghent University. During my studies, I built a strong foundation in computer science, with courses ranging from algorithms and data structures to software engineering and web development.

freeTime.title: Free Time
freeTime.description: In my free time, I enjoy cycling. I regularly participate in cycling events and enjoy challenging rides in the Flemish Ardennes. Cycling helps me clear my mind and recharge.

eventOrganiser.title: Event Organizer
eventOrganiser.description: For several years, I've been a co-organizer of a local quiz night. I'm responsible for planning, coordination, and practical execution of the event, as well as attracting participants and creating a pleasant and relaxed atmosphere.
